title: Acceptance under Boolean encoding
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a set, let $r$ be a natural number, let $T$ be a nonadaptive tester from functions $\Omega\to\mathbb{F}_2$ to Boolean acceptance, and let $f:\Omega\to\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$. The tester obtained by encoding Boolean transcript answers as elements of $\mathbb{F}_2$ has, on $f$, the same acceptance probability as $T$ on the function obtained by encoding each value of $f$ in $\mathbb{F}_2$.
